ministry: Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas
summary: Provides free LPG connections to women from below-poverty-line households to replace unclean cooking fuels.
benefits: Free LPG gas connection with financial support for the deposit; first refill and stove often subsidized.
eligibility: Adult woman from a BPL/eligible household
Household does not already have an LPG connection
application_steps: Apply at the nearest LPG distributor or via the PMUY online portal
